title: Meri Adalat
desc: A tough cop's life is torn apart after his sister and her lover are brutally murdered. He then decides to take the law into his own hands in order to seek justice for his sister.

title: Krishna Vrindha Vihari
desc: Krishna, from a traditional family, loves Vrinda. He faces the challenge of persuading his parents to accept their love and bless their marriage. It's a romantic, family-friendly story.

title: Anaconda
desc: Terry and her team rescue Paul who leads them to the hideout of the dreaded Anaconda, instead of the tribe they are in search of.

title: Mck Macharla Chunaav Kshetra
desc: A district collector fights a corrupt politician to ensure peaceful elections, facing power struggles, love, and vengeance in a tense political drama set in a troubled region.

title: Raaz
desc: Sanjana and Aditya decide to give their marriage one last chance and plan a holiday in Ooty, unaware of the horror awaiting them.

title: Bhool Bhulaiya 3
desc: In Kolkata, Rooh Baba visits a haunted estate and faces two vengeful ghosts, each claiming to be Manjulika, leading to a mysterious and eerie confrontation.

title: Ismart Shankar
desc: Ismart Shankar, a killer, murders a politician. A cop, Arun, investigates but dies. Arun's memory is transferred into Shankar to solve the case.

title: Athidhi Devobhava
desc: A tale where hospitality turns sinister. A mysterious guest enters lives with charm and dark secrets. Suspense builds as the line between welcome and danger blurs.

title: Apradhi Kaun
desc: An unlikely gambler navigates risky deals and deception in a high-stakes world of cards, danger, and unpredictable alliances that test every instinct.
